units.title: Cost dashboard (web view of telemetry)
units.why: numbers in JSONL are inert; a 1-page dashboard with charts (per-tentacle USD, per-task-class breakdown, hourly heatmap) makes cost visible enough to manage
units.close_out_note: Built 2026-05-20 hotel-loop iter 3. Top-level aliases /cost-dashboard + /api/cost-aggregate registered in routes/index.ts as 302 redirects to /api/v1/cost/dashboard|aggregate.
